samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic logic unit (ALU) for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">A 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input operand a.</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input operand b.</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]">Shift amount for shifting operations.</assign>
        
        <assign signed_a = $signed(a); // Convert input operand a to signed representation
        <assign signed_b = $signed(b); // Convert input operand b to signed representation
        
        <assign r = res[31:0]; // Assign the lower 32 bits of the result to output port r
        <assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1'b1 : 1'bz; // Set flag to 1 if aluc is SLT or SLTU, else set it to high impedance
        <assign zero = ~(|res); // Check if the result is all zeros and assign 1 to zero if true, else assign 0
        <assign carry = res[32]; // Assign the carry bit from the result to output port carry
        <assign negative = res[31]; // Assign the sign bit from the result to output port negative
        <assign overflow = res[32]; // Assign the overflow bit from the result to output port overflow
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        reg [32:0] res; // Register to store the result of the operation
        integer i; // Loop variable for shifting operations
        always @(*) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= signed_a + signed_b; // Perform addition operation
                ADDU: res <= a + b; // Perform unsigned addition operation
                SUB: res <= signed_a - signed_b; // Perform subtraction operation
                SUBU: res <= a - b; // Perform unsigned subtraction operation
                AND: res <= a & b; // Perform bitwise AND operation
                OR: res <= a | b; // Perform bitwise OR operation
                XOR: res <= a ^ b; // Perform bitwise XOR operation
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b); // Perform bitwise NOR operation
                SLT: res <= (signed_a < signed_b) ? 1 : 0; // Perform signed comparison operation
                SLTU: res <= (a < b) ? 1 : 0; // Perform unsigned comparison operation
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0]; // Perform logical left shift operation
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // Perform logical right shift operation
                SRA: res <= signed_b >>> a[4:0]; // Perform arithmetic right shift operation
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0]; // Perform variable logical left shift operation
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // Perform variable logical right shift operation
                SRAV: res <= signed_b >>> a[4:0]; // Perform variable arithmetic right shift operation
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0}; // Load upper immediate operation
                default: res <= 33'hzzzzzzzzz; // Default case for undefined operations
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
